origin.description: Strip the comment, keep lines that start with concordance:, and expand the run-length encoding.

arguments.name: x
arguments.text: Character text that contains a concordance line.

origin.details: Several concordance lines are applied in order. The check is the single sample comment.
origin.example:
bp <- getFromNamespace("as.Rconcordance.default", "backports")
obj <- bp("<!-- concordance::Sample.Rmd:1 9 1 1 6 14 1 -->")
cat(obj$srcFile, length(obj$srcLine), "\n")
